title: SFT Learning Adventures
level_model: one fixed-screen animated story adventure per book, with a short replayable game in every connected story stage
narrative_cause_chain: Level Two asks how the whole lantern can pass through a small door; every puzzle advances the separate, carry and rebuild plan. Level Three begins when that lantern lights a trail; every puzzle repairs one visible part of the same journey to the Sunrise Arch.
plain_language_rule: Use the shortest familiar word that keeps the meaning exact. Child text uses door, letter box, note, box, part, gap and extra; technical boundary terms stay in adult guidance.

level_2: Parcel Dash: steer through a changing obstacle course
Lantern Detective: uncover all four visible parts of one lantern
Fit-the-Circle Lab: match four exact symmetrical lantern quadrants to one circular plan
Twin-Part Test: place lantern-part pairs on a balance and compare their sizes
Doorway Delivery: carry each of four lantern parts through the small door exactly once
Count-and-Collect: count the four visible lantern parts, including the two Pax holds
Gap Repair: choose, rotate and fit the matching curved lantern part
Lantern Builder: solve a four-piece lantern-picture jigsaw
Lantern Sum Builder: make 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4 parts, then join those four parts into one whole lantern
level_3: Moon-and-Sun Catch: move a catcher across three lanes and catch the four ordered lights
Two-Side Camera: turn one tile and record its two different faces
Gate Crank: pull the gate handle to its marked turn or use the touch alternative
Return Run: compare three complete paths and launch the tile through the one-turn return path
Path Builder: place three lawful lights from a moving belt
Rule Repair: replace the first broken move in a retained randomized row
Bridge Hop: guide Vee through five alternating over-and-under arches
Trail Mapper: inspect three complete maps and find the route that reaches the arch while keeping the rule
New-Role Relay: continue star-and-leaf roles from a fixed clue, then recall the first gate

mini_game_policy: Every stage in every level or book contains a short replayable learning mini-game with direct input, visible feedback and a clear learning purpose; narrative-only stages are not permitted.
sound_system: 92 caption-matched local Kokoro narration lines plus offline Web Audio movement and interaction effects
callback_policy: Sol, Tavi and Mia are permanent; each level introduces at most one guest; callbacks appear only when relevant and never identify a new answer.
mobile_navigation_guard: The application root and game stages use fixed-height overflow containment and overscroll-behavior none to prevent accidental pull-to-refresh or swipe-off scrolling.
progress_storage: device-local browser storage only; active level, exact scene, dialogue turn and unfinished activity are saved during play and when the page is hidden

final_publication.note: Awaiting Maria Smith's review and explicit approval; none of the first three books has been moved into publications/education.
